heritage.terroir_text: A raw reality of schist. Unique altitude and solar exposure forging an unforgiving but perfect ecosystem.
heritage.viticulture_text: Safeguarding the genetic heritage of the Douro through integrated, sustainable production.
heritage.adega_text: The 2004 architectural masterpiece. Designed with intentional false symmetries, blending raw functionality with award-winning aesthetic integration into the valley.
heritage.family_text: José António Castro Ramos Pinto Rosas (1919–1996) dedicated over 50 years to the Douro Valley — founder of ADVID, co-creator of modern vineyard systems, and revered internationally as the Pioneer of the Douro. Aged 72, he found a virgin 20-hectare property near Vila Nova de Foz Côa and planted 8.5 hectares of vines from scratch, with over 80% Touriga Nacional — the first to recognise it as Portugal’s finest variety. Today, his son Jorge Rosas, the fifth generation of wine producers, continues that legacy from the award-winning 2004 winery.
